conditions: applies to non-community water systems granted permission by the primacy agency under § 141.11(d) to exceed the nitrate MCL
claim_payload.subject: nitrate

declared_section_ambiguities: The value '10 mg/l' is stated as the posting threshold ('nitrate levels exceed 10 mg/l') rather than as an explicit statement that the nitrate MCL equals 10 mg/l; the has-mcl claim (c1) infers this equivalence from the section heading's reference to exceeding the nitrate MCL rather than from an explicit MCL definition in this section's body text.

evidence.exact_text: (b) What is the form and manner of the special notice? Non-community water systems granted permission by the primacy agency to exceed the nitrate MCL under § 141.11(d) must provide continuous posting of the fact that nitrate levels exceed 10 mg/l and the potential health effects of exposure, according to the requirements for Tier 1 notice delivery under § 141.202(c) and the content requirements under § 141.205.
